name: partner-in-project
description: Partner in Project — student project & hackathon collaboration platform (UCS503 Software Engineering Lab)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
